subject.title: feat: add Pioneer.ai as an inference provider with live model discovery

question: Should OpenClaw accept Pioneer as an official provider now, including the new auth/default/publishing surface and this PR's dependency graph changes?
rationale: The remaining blocker combines product ownership of a new official provider, supply-chain approval for manifest/lock/shrinkwrap changes, and user-facing provider/model-picker behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent policy.

options.title: Approve after narrowing
options.body: Keep the plugin implementation path, but merge only after dependency/security approval or lockfile scrubbing and explicit acceptance of configured picker live discovery.

options.title: Accept official provider as-is
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally own the new official provider, auth/default surface, dependency graph, and publishing metadata in this PR.

options.title: Route externally first
options.body: Ask the contributor to publish Pioneer as a self-maintained ClawHub/npm provider and land only generic missing external-provider API improvements separately.

recommendation.title: Approve after narrowing
recommendation.body: Keep the plugin implementation path, but merge only after dependency/security approval or lockfile scrubbing and explicit acceptance of configured picker live discovery.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is official provider ownership plus provider/Gateway/security policy, and steipete has the strongest adjacent history in those surfaces.
